items.name: kernel
items.verdict: Routine stable kernel bump; needs a reboot and an NVIDIA module rebuild.
items.reasoning: Kernel updates always require a reboot to take effect. The NVIDIA akmod must rebuild against 7.2.5 before this box has a working display driver. Nothing in the changelog touches the NVIDIA or DRM paths, so the rebuild should be uneventful.
items.notes_excerpt: Update to upstream stable release 7.2.5: fixes in ext4, btrfs and the amdgpu driver; no ABI changes.

items.name: akmod-nvidia
items.verdict: New NVIDIA driver series; rebuilds the kmod for the pending kernel.
items.reasoning: akmod packages compile a kernel module locally, so this pairs with the 7.2.5 kernel in the same transaction. Secure Boot is on, so the freshly built module has to be signed before it will load. Verify modinfo succeeds for the target kernel before rebooting.
items.notes_excerpt: 615.71.09: fixes Vulkan present timing on Blackwell (RTX 50xx), adds explicit sync support for Wayland compositors.

items.name: openssl
items.verdict: Important security fix for a certificate-parsing crash; install promptly.
items.reasoning: Rated important by Fedora because a malformed certificate can crash any process doing TLS verification. Every network client on the box links this library. No API change, so running services only need a restart, not a reboot.
items.notes_excerpt: CVE-2026-40311: out-of-bounds read in X509v3 GENERAL_NAME parsing can crash applications verifying attacker-supplied certificates.

items.name: systemd
items.verdict: Bugfix release for the init system; touches core services.
items.reasoning: systemd is PID 1, so it is flagged yellow on principle even for bugfixes. This release only fixes logind session tracking and a resolved cache leak. A daemon-reexec is handled by the package scriptlets.
items.notes_excerpt: Fix a session leak in logind when a Wayland session exits uncleanly; resolved no longer grows its cache without bound.

items.name: mesa-dri-drivers
items.verdict: Graphics stack point release; safe but affects the display path.
items.reasoning: Mesa sits under every GL and Vulkan client, so it is flagged yellow by policy. This is a stable point release with zver and radeonsi fixes only. The NVIDIA proprietary driver is unaffected.
items.notes_excerpt: mesa 26.1.5: assorted zink and radeonsi fixes; no Nouveau or NVK behaviour changes on Blackwell.

items.name: ripgrep
items.verdict: Minor bugfix to a command-line tool; no risk.
items.reasoning: A leaf CLI utility with no library consumers. The release fixes glob handling only. Nothing on the system depends on its behaviour.
items.notes_excerpt: Fix -g globs with a trailing slash matching files as well as directories.

items.name: org.freedesktop.Platform
items.verdict: Runtime update held back: Steam is running on this runtime.
items.reasoning: Flatpak cannot replace a runtime that a running app has open, so this is blocked until Steam quits. The update itself is a routine runtime refresh. Quit Steam and it becomes a green install.
items.notes_excerpt: freedesktop-sdk 25.08.9: glibc and mesa refresh inside the runtime, plus updated CA certificates.

items.name: org.freedesktop.Platform.GL.default
items.verdict: GL extension for the runtime above; blocked by the same running Steam.
items.reasoning: This ships the in-runtime graphics drivers and must move with the platform it extends. Steam holds it open, so Flatpak refuses to swap it. It will install cleanly once Steam is closed.
items.notes_excerpt: Rebuild of the GL extension against mesa 26.1.5.

items.name: org.gnome.Platform
items.verdict: GNOME runtime refresh, blocked while Steam keeps the stack in use.
items.reasoning: The GNOME runtime layers on the freedesktop platform that Steam is using, so the whole chain is pinned for now. The content is a normal stable GNOME 49 point update. No action needed beyond quitting Steam.
items.notes_excerpt: GNOME 49.3 runtime: GTK 4.20.3, glib 2.88.1, updated shared-mime-info.

items.name: com.spotify.Client
items.verdict: Routine app update; no system impact.
items.reasoning: A sandboxed desktop app that nothing else depends on. The update is a regular upstream release. Worst case is a restart of the app itself.
items.notes_excerpt: Upstream client update; playback and library fixes.

items.name: org.gimp.GIMP
items.verdict: Bugfix release of a sandboxed app; safe.
items.reasoning: GIMP runs inside its own sandbox with no system services behind it. This is a maintenance release with file-format fixes. Nothing else on the box is affected.
items.notes_excerpt: GIMP 3.2.6: fixes for PSD import and the curves tool.

items.name: samsung-990-pro
items.verdict: NVMe firmware update; staged now and applied during the next reboot.
items.reasoning: Storage firmware is written by the drive itself at the next power cycle, so fwupd only stages it here. The release notes list a power-loss-protection fix, which is worth having. Do not interrupt power while it applies.
items.notes_excerpt: 5B2QJXD7: improves power-loss protection handling and fixes a rare stall under sustained mixed workloads.

items.name: logitech-unifying
items.verdict: Small receiver firmware fix; applied live, no reboot.
items.reasoning: fwupd flashes the receiver in place and the device re-enumerates on its own. The change only affects pairing reliability. The keyboard and mouse reconnect within a second or two.
items.notes_excerpt: RQR24.18: fixes occasional loss of pairing after the host resumes from suspend.
